text:
nina: Heads-up: edge-sample is noisy in VS Code. Generics on client APIs become unresolved after esbuild bundles and tscserver shows overload errors. Works at runtime but editor is unhappy.

omar: Can you paste minimal repro? SDK version?

nina: js-sdk@1.5.2 in examples/edge-ts. Repro: 

```
import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const c = createClient();
await c.complete<{user: string}>({ prompt: 'x' });
```

VS Code: "No overload matches this call" or "Generic type requires X type argument(s)". Node project with same TS config is fine.

taylor: Common culprits: 1) package "exports" not mapping types per entrypoint; 2) pnpm hoisting pointing to wrong d.ts; 3) tsserver moduleResolution differs (node vs bundler).

nina: Confirmed: editor resolves to node_modules/.pnpm/@redwood+inference@1.5.2/node_modules/@redwood/inference/index.d.ts which is a tiny shim missing overloads. The published package has dist/types/index.d.mts with full signatures.

omar: Short fixes for consumers: set "moduleResolution": "bundler" in tsconfig (TS>=4.7), or add a tsconfig "paths" override pointing to the SDK's dist types file. Both work around resolution mismatch.

taylor: SDK-side fixes we should ship: - emit dual declaration files (index.d.mts/index.d.cts) - add explicit "types" entries inside "exports" mapping so TS picks the right file for import/require - produce a small flattened "index.api.d.ts" that exposes the stable generic signatures with defaults (e.g. <T = Record<string, unknown>>).

nina: Also saw issues where overload chains used unknown vs any and inference collapsed after bundling. Suggest replacing long overload chains with a single generic signature + narrower helper types to improve inference under constrained bundlers.

omar: And disable declarationMap in published artifacts or ensure sources are published; editors chase maps and fail if they point to non-existent files.

taylor: Let's add a minimal consumer-sim CI job: create a tiny pnpm project, install the packaged SDK, run tsc --noEmit with both moduleResolution=node and moduleResolution=bundler to catch regressions.

build-bot: CI alert: examples/edge-ts lint-ts job failed (see internal link)

nina: I'll open a PR: (1) add exports->types mapping, (2) emit .d.mts/.d.cts and flat api d.ts, (3) disable declarationMap before publish, (4) add edge-ts tsconfig example and CI consumer check.

omar: If you can add the tiny repro into tests I'll review. Also let's document a short troubleshooting note for customers: why moduleResolution matters and the quick tsconfig path fix.

taylor: Thanks — this should cut down support noise. :rocket:
